mechanism: Actual installed browsers through playwright-core; owned loopback server; separate per-channel test build directories; disposable synthetic browser contexts and native IndexedDB; NODE_ENV=test renderer.
observations: Unsubmitted worked help survives selecting the same badge, switching away and back, reloading, and revisiting the same semantic case through another representation. A different semantic case and the other badge retain their own context.
Viewing help creates no assessment observation, completion count or mastery evidence. A subsequent correct answer preserves saved maximum assistance and worked-solution exposure.
A held tier-three save leaves tier two visible until commit. The initiating keyboard help focus returns after commit, while a deliberate move to another available control remains respected.
An aborted tier-three save reveals no worked answer; reloading restores the previously committed tier two.

An explicit new v2 session clears current-session support and changes the replay seed without adding assessment or completions. A later fresh answer remains limited evidence and does not satisfy readiness by itself.
verificationIncident: The first sandboxed Chrome attempt was blocked at initial owned-loopback navigation by ERR_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED before product assertions. The same unchanged checks passed with scoped tool permission; Edge used that same scoped permission. No assertion or source was weakened.
privacy: Only synthetic badges and fixed mathematical fixtures; retained data is paths, hashes, browser versions, named test outcomes and aggregate observations. No browser profile, record/database dump, identifying content, screenshot, trace or audio is retained.
limits: This verifies bounded browser behavior in the test renderer; independent production rendering and the full browser matrices remain separate evidence.
No physical device restart/disconnection, native zoom, actual assistive-technology delivery, native-language review, owner/child UX acceptance or educational validity is inferred.
Per-session fresh-task recovery is an explicit engineering hypothesis, not a time-based retention or mastery claim.
Full local/fresh gates, audit, final complete-candidate privacy review and exact-head hosted/merge eligibility belong to the main quality gate.
